annotations.title: What's launching now: ticker waves and copycats

description: New tokens launched on Robinhood Chain in the last hours (default 6, up to 72), read from the chain within minutes: how many and how fast against the window before, waves of new tokens sharing one ticker (how many copies, how many different launchers, when the wave started, and which copy has the most liquidity now), the wallets launching the most, and the contracts most launches go through. Pass symbol for one ticker's copies in the window, each with its launcher and liquidity now. Use for 'what's launching?', 'what's trending on Robinhood Chain?', 'how many CLAUS clones are there?', 'is this the real one?'. A ticker is not an identity. From Fivebar's launch index of every Uniswap v3 and v4 pool on Robinhood Chain.

min.description: New tokens with one ticker that make a wave, default 3

symbol.description: Optional: one ticker, to list its copies
